strings.note: Market tablet: caption on the first department tab (refill the bottles already behind the bar). 160-unit tab with a 24px icon on its left; 16px shop face, wraps then truncates, ~10 characters.
Market tablet: caption on the department tab for spirits, liqueurs and beer. Same tab as hud.shop.tab.restock, ~10 characters.
Market tablet: caption on the department tab for mixers, juices, syrups and garnishes (the non-alcoholic side). Same tab as hud.shop.tab.restock, ~10 characters.
Market tablet: caption on the department tab where new drinks for the recipe book are bought. Same tab as hud.shop.tab.restock, ~10 characters.
Market tablet: caption on the department tab for room fittings (walls, lights, furniture). Same tab as hud.shop.tab.restock, ~10 characters.

strings.text: Point at anything to read it. You only pay when you place the order.
strings.note: Market tablet: grey hint in the empty basket at the foot of the page. Sentence case, 12px body face, wraps in a ~780-unit box, two sentences.

strings.text: STILL IN THE SHAKER — POUR IT INTO A GLASS
strings.note: Red toast under the top bar when the player backs out of the bench with a drink still in the shaker (it has not been poured into a glass yet). Capitals, display face 14, one line, ~44 characters.

strings.text:
THE BAR IS CLOSED
three days losing money — NEW RUN to try again
strings.note: Big red banner over the room when the run is lost (three nights in the red in a row). Line 1 capitals, line 2 lower case; keep the \n. NEW RUN is the caption of the key in Settings that starts over (chrome.settings.new_run) and should match it. Display face 22 in a 900x120 box.
Top bar, left: small caption over the night number in the day well (the number is drawn under it). 8px body face, centred in a 52-unit column, ~7 characters.
Top bar: title row of the hover card over the day well (star icon on its left). Capitals, 8px face, one line, short.

Top bar: second row of the hover card over the day well. {day} = the run's day number, {week} = the week number, {night} = tonight's name in capitals (calendar.night.*, e.g. FRIDAY). Keep the two spaces either side of each dot. The card grows to fit, one line, ~36 characters.
Week calendar instrument (top bar centre and the night curtain card): small caption over the week number, left of the seven night names. 8px body face, centred in a 52-unit column, ~7 characters.

Story plate (bottom of the room, the last customer's face and words on the left): caption on the small dark key that turns their request down for tonight. Key is 150x32, 8px body face, ~18 characters.
Market tile state row (small word beside a van icon, bottom of the card): this item was ordered tonight and arrives tomorrow. Capitals, 16px row on a ~150-unit card, ~12 characters.
Market tile state row (beside a return-arrow icon): the item can be returned for its money. Capitals, same row as hud.tile.state.on_the_van, ~12 characters.
Market tile state row (beside a padlock icon): the room has no spot this fitting can stand in. Capitals, same row as hud.tile.state.on_the_van, ~12 characters.
Market tile state row (beside a stock icon): this bottle is already full behind the bar, nothing to buy. Capitals, same row as hud.tile.state.on_the_van, ~12 characters.
Top bar, right: one word to the left of the five hearts that fill with tonight's drinks rating. 8px body face, right-aligned in a 70-unit box, ~10 characters.
Top bar, right: one word to the left of the five medallions that fill with the room's rating (walls, light, furniture). 8px body face, right-aligned in a 70-unit box, ~10 characters.
Title row of the hover card over the hearts strip (heart icon on its left). Capitals, one line, short.
Second row of the hover card over the hearts strip when no run is going. Capitals, one line; the card grows to fit, ~34 characters.
Second row of the hover card over the hearts strip. {rating} = tonight's drinks rating with one decimal (e.g. 3.5), out of 5 stars. Capitals, one line; the card grows to fit, ~30 characters.
Title row of the hover card over the medallions strip (medallion icon on its left). Capitals, one line, short.

strings.text: WHAT THE ROOM IS WORTH: WALLS, LIGHT, FURNITURE
strings.note: Second row of the hover card over the medallions strip when no run is going. Capitals, one line; the card grows to fit, ~48 characters.

strings.text: THE ROOM NOW: {rating} OF 5 - WALLS, LIGHT, FURNITURE
strings.note: Second row of the hover card over the medallions strip. {rating} = the room's rating right now with one decimal (e.g. 2.5), out of 5 stars. Capitals, one line; the card grows to fit, ~52 characters.

strings.text:
STANDING - A STEP A NIGHT TOWARD THE LOWER OF
SERVICE AND COMFORT
strings.note: Hover card over the top bar's five stars (the bar's standing). ONE sentence set over the card's two rows: the part before the \n is the title row, the part after it the second row; keep exactly one \n. Meaning: each night the stars move one step toward whichever of the two ratings (service, comfort) is lower. When a run is going, the title row stays and the second row is replaced by build.standing.tip_reading, so the title must still read well followed by that formula. Capitals; the card grows to fit, ~46 characters a row.

Second row of the hover card over the top bar's stars while a run is going, under the title row of build.standing.tip. {service} and {comfort} = tonight's two ratings, {tonight} = the lower of them (what tonight is filed at), each with one decimal (e.g. 3.0). Keep the spacing around · and =. Capitals, one line, ~46 characters.
Title row of the hover card over the cog key at the top bar's right end. Capitals, one line, short.

strings.text: SOUND, MOTION, THE BOOK, A NEW RUN
strings.note: Second row of the hover card over the cog key: what the settings window holds (sound, reduced motion, tonight's ledger, starting over). Capitals, one line; the card grows to fit, ~36 characters.
Amber title at the top of the day-end screen while the night's receipt is shown (the market step replaces it with dayend.market.title). Display face 16, one line in a 900-unit box, ~30 characters.
Big amber line in the middle of the dark screen at closing time, shown alone for a moment before the receipt prints. Display face 24, one line, ~20 characters.
Grey line under build.dayend.called at closing time. Lower case on purpose; 16px body face, one line, ~34 characters.
Printed heading at the top of the night's till receipt (the paper slip at day end); the date line sits under it. Display face 24 on a ~396-unit paper, one line, ~16 characters.
Caption on the full-width amber key at the foot of the till receipt, before the screen sets its real caption (dayend.bill.next). Display face 16 on a 456x44 key, one line, ~20 characters.

Market tablet: the phone-carrier name in the device's grey status bar, centred between the clock and the wifi/battery icons. A made-up network name; 8px body face, one line in a 200-unit box, ~16 characters.
Market tablet title bar, right: small label over the money readout (the till's balance) in the dark sunken box. 8px body face, 80-unit box, ~10 characters.

Market basket head band (dark strip at the page foot): small label left of what the basket's order costs. 8px shop face, right-aligned in a 60-unit box, ~7 characters. Look test compares this band pixel for pixel in English.

Market basket head band: small label left of the money the till will have after the order. 8px shop face, right-aligned in a 130-unit box, ~16 characters. Look test compares this band pixel for pixel in English.

strings.text: {money} to spend at the market and on the room.
strings.note: Hover line under THE TILL. {money} is the till's money with its sign, e.g. "$2520". One line of ~40 characters.
Hover title over the till's green readout on the top bar (2026-09-22). One short line.
